title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1415 West Oak Street, in Kissimmee, Florida, as the "Borinqueneers Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1415 West Oak Street, in Kissimmee, Florida, as the "Borinqueneers Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A 2018 law renamed a Kissimmee, Florida post office building in honor of the Borinqueneers, a Puerto Rican military unit.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives an official name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1415 West Oak Street in Kissimmee, Florida. The building is now called the "Borinqueneers Post Office Building." The name honors the Borinqueneers, the Puerto Rican unit that served in the U.S. Army. The law does not change postal services, mail rules, or costs.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on March 23, 2018.
